Each guidance has when, inspection, relation_if_established, evidence_requirement and source_operations. A null relation is an evidence/inspection procedure, never NM. When the same inspection establishes different labels under different conditions, prefer separately clear conditional records, not a mixed rule whose implicit label the weak lawyer must reconstruct. Scope may cover several original hypotheses only when that same procedure transfers. No fixed count/types or compulsory hypothesis coverage. source_operations is [] or [list_preamble]. This factual operation starts from ordinary source candidates in the public scope, finds possible governing list introductions and adds optional original-span links. It does not determine legal dependencies, labels or final evidence. There are no source_triggers, case eligibility, legal host decisions or answer repairs. Both full-master serialization and total semantic projection over the17 questions must fit the supplied token cap; shared-scope text is charged each time delivered. No pruning or fallback if over capacity. Return only the requested library within both stated token budgets.
